title: Albaloo strategy task manifest (bridge.v1)
description: The shape Gemini (or any external strategist) fills so a directive is machine-checkable and routable to the nine agents. A manifest is a PROPOSAL, never an execution: it is validated, compliance-prescreened, and reviewed before any agent acts on it.

rationale.description: why this task, in one or two sentences

payload.description: action-specific; see README for per-action shape

sources.description: URLs or named datasets the directive rests on. A task with no source is a suggestion, not a directive, and is rejected.

gsc_backed.description: true only if a Search Console figure backs it. The pipeline reads GSC itself via Agent 1; a manifest that merely restates GSC duplicates work — reserve manifests for what the pipeline cannot see.

live_retrieval.description: true if this rests on a live web/AI-answer read (Perplexity, AI Overviews). This is Gemini's unique lane — the surface Agent 9 cannot measure from the base model.
